title: Zee Li Hyuin

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 372
Date 5/6/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

5th June 1916.

Sir,

A military officer named Zee Li Hyuin 徐連勳
arrived in Shanghai from Nanking on 3rd instant.
Zee is said to have been sent here by Chiangchun
Feng to confer with the local rebel leaders.
It is reported that Director Li of the
Arsenal has instructions not to supply arms to
anybody except on instructions from Chiangchun
Feng Kou Chang. Deputy Military Governor Lu
applied to Director Li for five hundred rifles a
few days ago but his application was not entertained.
Sun Yat Sen is arranging to hold a rebel
conference in Shanghai.
It is reported that General Yang will
visit Nanking soon.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第 372 号
日期 1916年6月5日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年6月5日。

先生：

一名名为徐連勳（Zee Li Hyuin）的军官于本月3日从南京抵达上海。
据称，徐是奉冯国璋（Chiangchun Feng）之命前来此地，与当地叛乱首领进行会晤。
据报道，兵工厂李总监接有指令，除凭冯国璋（Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang）的手令外，不得向任何人供应武器。数日前，陆军副督军卢向李总监申请五百支步枪，但其申请未获受理。
孙中山正安排在上海召开叛乱会议。
据报道，杨将军不久将访问南京。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

总探长。

警务处巡官队长。
